metadata.description:
A 6-step success rate analysis workflow where a user progressively
explores Horizon Europe success rates from overall programme statistics,
down to cluster-level and country-level comparisons, concluding with
factors that improve success. Tests the system's ability to provide
accurate statistics, identify trends, and explain causal factors.
